title: How to DRAW a BUBBLE in PROCREATE #Shorts - Quick Procreate Tutorial
description:
Procreate Short Tutorial!
In this short video I will show you how to draw a bubble in Procreate by using the liquify tool. It's super fun and easy!

Want more short tutorials? Leave a comment!

In this short Procreate tutorial we'll do the following to create this lovely bubble
✔ Tap you background layer and set it to a very dark color
✔ Create a layer with bright colors like shown in the video
✔ Blur the colors a bit by using Gaussian Blur
✔ Use Liquify set to Expand to create a bubble shape (don't hold the pen in place for too long)
✔ Make a new layer on top and draw a perfectly round circle (you can use the monoline brush), hold your pen in place after drawing a circle to make it snap to the Quick Shape and then tap one finger on the screen to make it snap to a perfectly round circle
✔ Fill the circle
✔ Tap the layer with the circle and pick 'select' 
✔ Tap the layer with the colorful blob and pick 'copy'
✔ Turn off the layers and make a new layer on top
✔ Go to the Actions menu, then to Add and pick 'Paste'
✔ Use the eraser set to the soft brush (under airbrushing) to remove a little bit of the centre of the bubble, if necessary
✔ Add highlights to the bubble using the Lightbrush (under Luminance)
✔ Duplicate the layer with the bubble multiple times, make some bubble small and some very big, spread them out over the canvas
✔ Use Gaussian blur on the bubbles that are either in the distance or very close to the foreground

Now you'll never wonder how to easily draw bubbles in Procreate again!
